descripcion_geo: City on the coastal plain of Sefela, between Jaffa and Jerusalem. Called Lida in the NT.
importancia_estrategica: Transit city between the port of Jaffa and Jerusalem; scene of the healing of Aeneas by Peter.

historias.titulo: The sons of Benjamin found Lod
historias.descripcion: The city of Lod was founded by the sons of Elpaal of the tribe of Benjamin.

historias.titulo: The return of exiles to Lod
historias.descripcion: Among the exiles returning from Babylon are 725 inhabitants of Lod, Hadid and Ono.
In Lydda (Lod), Peter visits the believers and heals Aeneas, paralyzed for eight years.

personajes.descripcion: He healed Aeneas in Lydda; His ministry on the coastal plain prepared the way for Cornelius' conversion.
Paralyzed for eight years who was healed by Peter in Lida; His healing converted the entire plain.
His sons founded Lod, Ono and Guéber.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Benjaminite city converted into a scene of apostolic miracles; Aeneas' healing paved the way for Peter's ministry in Caesarea.

cristianismo.descripcion: Peter heals the paralytic Aeneas in Lydda with the words 'Jesus the Messiah heals you'; all the inhabitants of the plain are converted.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Peter heals the paralytic Aeneas in Lydda with the words 'Jesus the Messiah heals you'; all the inhabitants of the plain are converted.

historias.titulo: Peter in Lydda: the healing of Aeneas
historias.descripcion: Peter visits the disciples in Lydda and heals Aeneas, paralyzed for eight years; all those from Sharon and Lydda are converted.

historias.titulo: Lida: stopover between Jaffa and Caesarea
historias.descripcion: Peter passed through Lydda on his way to Caesarea where he would baptize Cornelius, the first Gentile.

historias.titulo: The early church on the coastal plain
historias.descripcion: The healing of Aeneas in Lydda was the catalyst for the evangelization of the entire plain of Sharon.

personajes.descripcion: He performed the miracle that opened the entire coastal plain to the gospel.
His healing was the sign that converted the entire region.
In Jaffa, near Lydda, Peter resurrected Tabita; Both miracles prepared his meeting with Cornelius.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Lida was the bridge between the Galilean-Jewish ministry of Peter and its opening to the Gentiles in Caesarea.

cristianismo.descripcion: Peter's miracles in Lydda and Jaffa prepared his meeting with Cornelius: the gospel advances from city to city towards the Gentiles.
cristianismo.significado_teologico: Peter's miracles in Lydda and Jaffa prepared his meeting with Cornelius: the gospel advances from city to city towards the Gentiles.
